hosts.jumpTaskDescription: Open a paired host's Pleiad in a window on this PC
hosts.heading: Paired hosts
hosts.empty: No hosts yet. Add one under "Add a host" below.
hosts.removeConfirm: Remove "{{host}}" from this PC? It stays in the host's device list, so revoke it on the host when you no longer use it.
hosts.revokedHint: To pair again, create a new code on the host and paste it under "Add a host".
hosts.storagePlain: Credentials can't be encrypted on this PC (they are saved in a file only you can read).

add.heading: Add a host
add.help: On the host's Pleiad, open Settings › Remote › "Add a device", choose "Copy code", and paste it here.
add.label: Pairing code
add.codeHint: Check that the host shows the same number before approving.
add.fullAccess: An added device can do everything the host's user can. If you lose it, revoke it from the host's device list.
